title: cellsnp
description: cellSNP aims to pileup the expressed alleles in single-cell or bulk RNA-seq data. It can be directly used for donor deconvolution in multiplexed single-cell RNA-seq data, particularly with vireo.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

sam_file.description: Indexed sam/bam file(s), comma separated multiple samples. Mode 1a & 2a: one sam/bam file with single cell. Mode 1b & 2b: one or multiple bulk sam/bam files, no barcodes needed, but sample ids and regionsVCF.

sam_index_file.description: Input SAM/BAM Index file, problem with samFileList.

sam_fileList.description: A list file containing bam files, each per line, for Mode 1b & 2b.

regions_vcf.description: A vcf file listing all candidate SNPs, for fetch each variants. If None, pileup the genome. Needed for bulk samples.

targets_vcf.description: Similar as --regions_vcf, but the next position is accessed by streaming rather than indexing/jumping (like -T in samtools/bcftools mpileup).

barcode_file.description: A plain file listing all effective cell barcode.

sample_list.description: A list file containing sample IDs, each per line.

genotype.description: If use, do genotyping in addition to counting.

gzip.description: If use, the output files will be zipped into BGZF format.

print_skip_snps.description: If use, the SNPs skipped when loading VCF will be printed.

chrom.description: The chromosomes to use in integer format 1-22, comma separated

cell_tag.description: Tag for cell barcodes, turn off with None.

umi_tag.description: Tag for UMI: UR, Auto, None. For Auto mode, use UR if barcodes is inputted, otherwise use None. None mode means no UMI but read counts.

doublet_gl.description: If use, keep doublet GT likelihood, i.e., GT=0.5 and GT=1.5.

incl_flag.description: Required flags: skip reads with all mask bits unset.

excl_flag.description: Filter flags: skip reads with any mask bits set [UNMAP,SECONDARY,QCFAIL (when use UMI) or UNMAP,SECONDARY,QCFAIL,DUP (otherwise)]

count_orphan.description: If use, do not skip anomalous read pairs.

min_len.description: Minimum mapped length for read filtering.

output.description: Output directory for VCF and sparse matrices.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
